name: node-vuln-responder
description: Scan, patch, verify and check for compromise after Node.js security releases (ships with the October 2026 release: 10 CVEs incl. Brotli RCE CVE-2026-111497). Read-only scripts, approval-gated changes, bilingual EN/ES comms. Covers HTTP2Shell (CVE-2026-111497): Node, Bun, system Brotli library and Express 5 body parsing.
